DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Used to specify Product1 Schema property mappings that map to BIS Core properties. Overriding BIS Core properties to add custom attributes causes the propert to be added as a shared column attribute

DMProperty.description: List of BisCore property mappings, format "BisCorePropName,OpenPlantPropertyName;BisCorePropName,OpenPlantPropertyName"

DMCustomAttributeClass.description: Used to specify Product1 Schema class and property origin for this schema

DMProperty.description: Name of Product1 equivalent class or property
Additional Product1 class or property names, multiple entries separated by a semicolon
